questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Guyana?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Guyana article.

questions.proof: Georgetown is the capital; like most of the country's settlements, it is on a flat coastal plain that goes from northwest to southeast.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Guyana?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Guyana on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Guyana article.

questions.proof: Venezuela claims the land west of the Essequibo River as part of Guayana Esequiba.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “The term "cooperative republic" however dates back from _____.”

hints.nudge: It is a year in the twentieth century.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Guyana article.

questions.proof: The term "cooperative republic" however dates back from 1961.
